data.long_meaning: The name Kitti is of Greek origin and translates to 'Pure, Little One'. It is a feminine name often used in Christian and spiritual traditions to represent purity and innocence. The name Kitti carries the meaning “Pure, Little One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kitti usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kitti total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Kitti carries a deep meaning. It represents a soul untouched by the impurities of the world, pure in spirit and untarnished by the harshness of life. It is a reminder of the innocence and purity that exists within every individual, often seen as a connection to the divine.
